subject: bio
title: Cell Membranes and Transport
subtitle: Cell Membranes and Transport with mechanism-focused explanation and exam-linked examples.
concept: Cell membranes are selectively permeable barriers that regulate exchange between cell and environment. The phospholipid bilayer creates a hydrophobic core that limits passage of polar molecules.
The fluid mosaic model explains both structure and behavior. Lipids and proteins can move laterally, making membranes dynamic rather than rigid.
Transport processes are driven by gradients and energy availability. Understanding when ATP is required is central to exam questions.
